name: Name
keepPassword: Leave blank to keep the current password
requestFailed: The server request could not be completed
brandTagline: Manage your convenience store with ease
operationsSubtitle: Stock corrections, non-commercial receipts and internal withdrawals. Do not record purchases or sales here.
wasteSubtitle: Record damaged, expired or lost products
reportsSubtitle: View inventory and stock movement information
demoAuthNotice: Demo access. Real authentication will be integrated with the backend.
sessionRestoreFailed: The saved session is invalid or could not be restored. Please sign in again.
sessionStorageFailed: Session storage could not be accessed. Check your browser settings.
reviewCompleted: I have reviewed stock and history
partialWriteWarning: The operation may be incomplete. Do not submit it again without reviewing stock and history. Reload the data and check the records before continuing.
requestInProgress: A request is already in progress. Wait for it to finish.
loadProductsFailed: Could not load products. Make sure JSON Server is running and try loading again.
loadUsersFailed: Users could not be loaded. Check your connection and the catalog service.
loadOperationsFailed: Movements could not be loaded. Check that JSON Server is available.
loadWastesFailed: Waste records could not be loaded. Check that JSON Server is available.
noReportData: There are no records for this report.
accessDeniedMessage: Your account does not have permission to perform this action.
invalidProductPrice: Price must be a number greater than or equal to zero.
invalidProductStock: This product has invalid stock data. Ask an administrator to review it.
deleteProductConfirmation: Delete "{name}"? This is only allowed if there are no movements or waste records. This action cannot be undone.
productHasHistory: Cannot delete: this product has movements or waste records. Its history must be preserved.
productHistoryCheckFailed: History could not be verified. The product was not deleted. Check JSON Server and try again.
stockReadOnlyHint: Stock is updated through movements and waste records. It cannot be changed in this form.
tableScrollHint: Scroll the table to see all columns.
newProductSubtitle: Add a product to your store inventory.
productFormHint: Complete the product details before saving.
movementFormHint: For corrections, manual receipts and internal use. The current contract does not store reasons; a backend extension is required.
accessDeniedHelp: Return to home to find the tasks available to your account.
loginDescription: Everything you need to manage your store inventory, in one place.
loginBenefitMovements: Record what comes in and goes out
quickActionsHint: Choose the task you need to complete.
lastRegisteredMovements: The latest records from your inventory.
alertsNeedAttention: A quick look at what needs your attention.
noMatchingProducts: No matching products. Try another search or clear the filters.
stockPreviewHint: This is an estimate. Stock will be fetched and validated again when you confirm.
stockChangedReview: Stock has changed. Review the updated preview and confirm again. The operation was not recorded.
recentReceivedHint: Last 10 list records, shown from the end. Original date text is preserved.
alertsInteractiveHint: Expired and out-of-stock products first. A product can have more than one alert.
noFilteredAlerts: No alerts match these filters. Try another category or search.
noAlerts: There are no alerts in the available data.
reportsInteractiveHint: View available records. Sales and profit are not included.
inventorySnapshotNotice: This inventory shows current stock. Date ranges do not apply to this view.
invalidReportPeriod: Check the period: dates must be valid and From cannot be later than To.
unknownDateNotice: {count} records have an unverified date. Their original text is displayed. Selecting a period will exclude them and results may be incomplete.
partialDateResults: Partial results: {count} records were excluded because their dates cannot be reliably interpreted. These results do not represent the complete history for the period.
csvPartialScope: Partial: {count} records excluded due to unverified dates.
availableRecordsScope: Based only on the available records.
commercialCartHint: Add products, review quantities and confirm the summary.
commercialEmptyCart: Add at least one product to continue.
commercialDuplicate: This product is already in the cart. Update its existing line.
commercialAmountError: Check the price or cost: use a valid amount with up to two decimal places.
commercialZeroNotice: An amount is zero. Check that it is correct before confirming.
commercialConsistencyNotice: If registration encounters a problem, review the document status before trying again.
commercialSaved: Operation completed and inventory movements recorded.
commercialChanged: Stock or price changed. Review the updated values and confirm again.
commercialWriteUncertain: Not all steps were confirmed. Review the document before operating on these products again. Do not resubmit this cart.
commercialAttemptLocked: This attempt already has a tracking document. This form cannot submit it again.
commercialVerifyFailed: We could not verify the records. Check the connection again. Do not confirm another operation with these products until the issue is resolved.
commercialJournalFailed: Local tracking could not be read or saved. The operation is blocked to prevent duplicates.
commercialProductBlocked: This product has a pending operation and cannot be changed yet. Do not repeat that operation.
commercialLoadFailed: Commercial history could not be loaded.
commercialHistoryHint: Review documents, totals and statuses. Confirmed records are retained for traceability.
commercialNoDocuments: There are no commercial documents yet.
commercialTimeZone: Dates are displayed and filtered in Lima time (America/Lima).
commercialReadOnly: Read-only document. Voids and returns are unavailable in this phase.
commercialFailedNotice: This document was not completed and has no confirmed inventory changes.
commercialPendingNotice: This record needs review. Do not resubmit: some products may already have been updated. Ask the administrator to review what happened.
commercialDemoIdentity: This demo account does not provide verified employee identity.
commercialLocalOnly: We could not confirm this record with the service. Its tracking is retained in this browser. Do not resubmit until the issue has been reviewed.
posSubtitle: Search, add products and confirm the total.
posProductPending: Needs review before another operation can be registered.
posEmptyCart: Find a product and select Add to start.
posConfirmStockHint: Stock and prices will be checked before registration.
posConnectionTitle: Purchases and sales could not be checked
posServiceMissing: The service is connected but purchases and sales are unavailable. Check that JSON Server was started from the correct project. Registration is blocked until it can be verified.
posServiceUnavailable: The service cannot respond right now. Your cart is preserved. Check the connection again before confirming.
posServiceOffline: Could not connect to the server. Make sure JSON Server is running.
posHistoryHint: Review records and quickly find what you need.
posPendingCount: {count} records need review. Their products cannot be used in new operations until the issue is reviewed.
posReadOnly: Review the products and registration result.
askAdminProduct: Ask an administrator to register this product.
zeroStockProduct: Created with stock 0. Stock increases when the purchase completes.
loginServiceUnavailable: Could not reach the local server. Check that JSON Server is running and try again.
reviewReadOnly: Review what happened. This screen does not change stock or resolve operations.
reviewMovementConflict: Linked movements do not fully and uniquely match this tracking record. Evidence needs review.
reviewMovementFound: The movement matches this line and its saved reference. This alone does not prove the entire operation completed.
reviewStockUncertain: This evidence cannot confirm the stock write result. Do not register the operation again to correct it.
reviewPhase_stock_attempted: Stock update prepared or attempted; unconfirmed
reviewPhase_stock_applied: Tracking records a stock response; remaining steps need verification
reviewPhase_movement_attempted: Movement registration prepared or attempted; unconfirmed
reviewPhase_recorded: Tracking records a movement; compare the evidence
reviewLoadFailed: Could not load the review. Check your access and refresh.
reviewPartial: Evidence is missing. These sources could not be read:
reviewIncompleteList: No verifiable results from available sources. The list may be incomplete.
reviewEmpty: No pending operations found in queried sources. Other browsers may have different tracking records.
reviewDiscrepancy: The server and browser, or multiple tracking records, disagree. They are shown separately; neither is assumed correct.
reviewLocalOnly: Only browser tracking is available. This does not confirm the operation was saved on the server.
reviewNoInference: Current stock is a separate query: matching earlier or expected stock does not prove whether this operation changed stock. This query is neither a complete audit nor an atomic read.
reviewSummary: A pending tracking record exists. The full outcome needs verification; inventory remains protected.
commercialBeforeWriteFailed: Could not verify the server before registration. No writes for this operation were started. Your cart is kept; check the connection and confirm again.
commercialPendingHelp: Do not repeat this operation. Its outcome still needs confirmation. Check the available evidence before requesting a correction.
catalogEmptyStock: This product is out of stock. Record a purchase to replenish it.
catalogAvailabilityUnknown: Pending operations could not be checked. Make sure JSON Server is running and refresh before proceeding.
catalogRowNumberHint: Numbers show positions in this list; they are not product identifiers.
